mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the visual pathways was most worthwhile: the distinction between light entering the eye and nerve signals leaving it clarified how the eye connects to the brain.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the corneas and lenses felt repetitive because each result simply confirmed the fitting without explaining its contribution until the irises were added.

surprise.text: The explicit contrast between incoming light and outgoing nerve signals sharpened my understanding of what travels toward the brain.

arbitrary.text: The fittings all had a clear purpose, though their order seemed arbitrary: the menu allowed several choices and did not explain why one should come first.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter if it connected its parts to an everyday experience as the final image did. The mostly single-option sequence made this chapter feel more like guided assembly than a game with meaningful decisions.
